title.zh: 蘇刺史家女使：姓名未傳，讀誦未歇
title.en: An Unnamed Attendant: Continuing to Read the Sutra

person.en: An unnamed attendant in Su Chang’s household

aliases: An unnamed attendant in Su Chang’s household

note.zh: 唐武德年間；渡嘉凌江，後嫁揚州
note.en: Tang Wude era; a crossing of the Jialing River and later marriage in Yangzhou.

synopsis.zh: 蘇長家一位未具名女使平日讀經。船難中，原書述她戴經函至岸、經不濕；後嫁揚州仍勤讀誦。不是刺史女兒。
synopsis.en: An unnamed attendant in Su Chang’s household regularly read the sutra. The source reports her survival with its case during a shipwreck and continued practice after marriage; she is not the prefect’s daughter.

paragraphs.text: 唐武德中，都水使蘇長，授巴州刺史，帶家族赴官。因
渡嘉凌江，中流風作，船帆頎沒。男女六十餘人，一時
喪失。唯一女使，常讀法華法經。浪入船，女乃頭戴經
函，誓與俱沒。既而女即不沉，隨波泛泛。頃刻至岸，捧
函而上。開視其經，了無沾濕。此女後嫁於揚州，其篤
信讀誦，愈於舊也。〔注：法苑珠林〕
